## About
K H Automotive is a family-owned and operated repair shop in Mission, KS. We specialize in European vehicles such as Mercedes Benz, Land Rover, Jaguar and Porsche, and we work on domestic cars too.
Our team has worked at service stations, independent shops and dealerships, and our technicians have trained with makers including General Motors, Honda, Porsche, Saab, Audi, Jaguar, Mercedes Benz and Land Rover. Our owner, Kevin Hinckle, is an ASE certified master technician. Whether it is a routine oil change or a complex engine problem, we believe in quality service and clear, honest communication.
We hold a 4.4 rating from 87 Google reviews.

## Services
- Engine repair: Engine repair and rebuilds.
- Diagnostics: Diagnostics using equipment including Snap-On Verus Edge, Mercedes SDS and Vag-Com.
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes.
- Transmission repair: Repair for automatic and manual transmissions.
- Cooling systems: Water pumps, radiators, hoses and belts.
- Brakes, steering and suspension: Brakes, steering and suspension.
- Heating and air conditioning: Heater cores, compressors and more.
- Electrical: Electrical, including starters and alternators.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 913-403-0073.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in European vehicles such as Mercedes Benz, Land Rover, Jaguar and Porsche, and we also do domestic repair.

Q: Do you offer a warranty?
A: Yes. As a Napa Auto Care Center, we offer a 24 month, 24,000 mile nationwide warranty on most repairs.
